## 简体中文

### 修复

- 将实时拖动位置更新限制在被拖动图标的覆盖层，避免每次指针事件都重算整个任务栏。
- 仅在目标应用悬停预览激活时加载窗口预览快照，移除应用图标渲染中的同步辅助功能查询。
- 重排布局变化时保留现有应用图标视图并缓存图像，消除拖动期间整行闪烁。
- 松开鼠标时先将图标动画移动到最终任务栏位置，再恢复其背景和运行指示器。

## English

### Fixed

- Isolated live drag position updates to the dragged icon overlay instead of recomputing the entire taskbar on every pointer event.
- Loaded window preview snapshots only when the target app's hover preview activates, removing synchronous Accessibility queries from app icon rendering.
- Preserved existing app icon views and cached their images during reorder layout changes, eliminating the full-row flash while dragging.
- Animated the dragged icon into its final taskbar slot before restoring its background and running indicator on release.
